subject: ENGLISH
title: Clap the Syllables · M01 D10
objective: Count spoken syllables in familiar words.
introduction: A syllable is a spoken beat with a vowel sound. Clapping helps hear beats but does not by itself determine spelling. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: A part of a word with one vowel sound.
The letters a, e, i, o, u.
Something you hear with your ears.
